units.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.text: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.label: Art. 2.9.1

units.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.label: Art. 2.9.1

units.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.text: 1. A person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements, assessment of compliance with which is the subject of state control (supervision) or municipal control in accordance with Federal Law No. 248-FZ of 31 July 2020 'On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation', or a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with requirements, assessment of compliance with which is carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 85-FZ of 9 April 2026 'On the Organisation of Control and Supervisory Activities in Respect of Local Self-Government Bodies and Local Self-Government Officials and on Amendments to the Federal Law "On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Unified System of Public Authority"', shall be released from administrative liability if that person fulfils an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body that imposes on that person an obligation to remedy their violations of legislative requirements (hereinafter in this Article referred to as the agreement).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2.9.1

units.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.text: 2. The provisions of part 1 of this Article apply only to agreements for which the grounds and procedure for conclusion and for recognition as fulfilled or unfulfilled are provided for by Federal Law No. 248-FZ of 31 July 2020 'On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation' or Federal Law No. 85-FZ of 9 April 2026 'On the Organisation of Control and Supervisory Activities in Respect of Local Self-Government Bodies and Local Self-Government Officials and on Amendments to the Federal Law "On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Unified System of Public Authority"' and by Resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with those laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2.9.1

units.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.text: 3. The provisions of part 1 of this Article do not apply where an application to conclude an agreement is submitted after the day on which the administrative offence case materials are forwarded to the judge, body or official authorised to hear the administrative offence case, or where an analogous administrative offence is committed by a person who previously failed to fulfil an agreement, or by a person whose agreement was previously terminated before the expiry of the period for its fulfilment because that person failed to comply with its terms, including in respect of implementing a programme to remedy identified violations of mandatory requirements.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 2.9.1

units.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
units.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, an analogous administrative offence is an administrative offence provided for by the same part of the same article (the same article) of this Code as the administrative offence consisting in failure to fulfil (improper fulfilment of) the same mandatory requirement (obligation) the breach of which constituted the grounds for concluding the agreement.
units.label: Art. 2.9.1 · “Note. For the purposes of this Article, an analogous…”

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.label: Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.label: Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 1. Legal entities are subject to administrative liability for administrative offences in the cases provided for by the articles of Section II of this Code or by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 2. Where the articles of Sections I, III, IV and V of this Code do not specify that the rules established by those articles apply only to an individual or only to a legal entity, those rules apply equally to individuals and legal entities, except where, by their meaning, those rules relate to and can be applied only to an individual.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 3. Where several legal entities merge, the newly formed legal entity shall be held administratively liable for an administrative offence.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 4. Where a legal entity is absorbed into another legal entity, the absorbing legal entity shall be held administratively liable for an administrative offence.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 5. Where a legal entity is divided, or one or more legal entities are separated from a legal entity, administrative liability for an administrative offence shall be imposed on the legal entity to which, under the separation balance sheet, the rights and obligations relating to concluded transactions or property in connection with which the administrative offence was committed have passed.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 6. Where a legal entity of one type is converted into a legal entity of another type, the newly formed legal entity shall be held administratively liable for an administrative offence.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 7. In the cases specified in parts 3 - 6 of this Article, administrative liability for an administrative offence arises irrespective of whether the legal entity being held administratively liable knew of the administrative offence before completion of the reorganisation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 8. Administrative penalties imposed on a legal entity for an administrative offence before completion of its reorganisation in accordance with points 2 - 4 of part 1 of Article 3.2 of this Code shall be applied subject to the provisions of parts 3 - 6 of this Article.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 2.10

units.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
units.text: 9. Where an administrative offence is committed by the sole executive body of a legal entity and that body itself has the status of a legal entity, an administrative penalty shall be imposed on it within the sanction prescribed for legal entities.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 2.10

units.text: Chapter 3. Administrative penalties
units.label: Chapter 3. Administrative penalties

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 3. ADMINISTRATIVE PENALTIES
units.label: Chapter 3. Administrative penalties · “Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation.…”

units.text: Article 3.1. Purposes of administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 3.1

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.1. Purposes of administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 3.1

units.text: 1. An administrative penalty is a measure of liability established by the state for the commission of an administrative offence and is applied to prevent the commission of further offences both by the offender and by other persons.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.1

units.text: 2. An administrative penalty may not have as its purpose the degradation of the human dignity of an individual who has committed an administrative offence, the infliction of physical suffering on that individual, or harm to the business reputation of a legal entity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.1

units.text: Article 3.2. Types of administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 3.2

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.2. Types of administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 3.2

units.text: 1. The following administrative penalties may be established and applied for the commission of administrative offences:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 1) a warning;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 2) an administrative fine;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 3) repealed. — Federal Law No. 398-FZ of 28.12.2010;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 4) confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 5) deprivation of a special right granted to an individual;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 6) administrative arrest;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 7) administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 8) disqualification;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 9) administrative suspension of activities;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 10) compulsory work;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 11) an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 3.2

units.text: 2. The administrative penalties listed in points 1 - 4 and 9 of part 1 of this Article may be applied to a legal entity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.2

units.text: 3. The administrative penalties listed in points 3 - 11 of part 1 of this Article are established exclusively by this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.2

units.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.text: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 3.3

units.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 3.3

units.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.text: 1. A warning, an administrative fine, deprivation of a special right granted to an individual other than the right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type, administrative arrest, disqualification, administrative suspension of activities and compulsory work may be established and applied only as principal administrative penalties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.3

units.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.text: 2. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence, deprivation of the special right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type, administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, and an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held may be established and applied as either principal or additional administrative penalties. Deprivation of the special right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type is applied as an additional administrative penalty for administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 11.7.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.8, part 1 of Article 12.26 and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.3

units.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
units.text: 3. For one administrative offence, a principal administrative penalty, or a principal and an additional administrative penalty, may be imposed from among the penalties specified in the sanction of the applicable article of the Special Part of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative liability. If the sanction of the applicable article requires the imposition of both a principal and an additional administrative penalty, but one of them cannot be imposed on the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted, only the administrative penalty that can be imposed on that person shall be imposed.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.3

units.text: Article 3.4. Warning
units.label: Art. 3.4

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.4. Warning
units.label: Art. 3.4

units.text: 1. A warning is an administrative penalty expressed in the official censure of an individual or a legal entity. A warning shall be issued in writing.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.4

units.text: 2. A warning is established for administrative offences committed for the first time where there is no harm, or threat of harm, to human life and health, fauna and flora, the environment, cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or state security, no threat of natural or man-made emergencies, and no property damage.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.4

units.text: 3. Where the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences does not provide for the imposition of an administrative penalty in the form of a warning, an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine shall be replaced with a warning in accordance with Article 4.1.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.4

units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 1) the value of the object of the administrative offence at the time the administrative offence was completed or stopped;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 2) the amount of taxes, levies or customs duties unpaid and payable at the time the administrative offence was completed or stopped, or the amount of an unlawful foreign exchange transaction, or the amount of funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, or the amount of funds credited during the reporting period to an electronic means of payment provided by a foreign payment service provider, or the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed period to accounts with authorised banks, or the amount of funds calculated as a multiple of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds credited to accounts with authorised banks after the prescribed deadline, or the amount of funds not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed period, or the amount of funds due to a resident from a non-resident, or the amount of funds, the value of securities or other property, or the value of services of a proprietary nature unlawfully transferred or provided on behalf of a legal entity, or the amount of an unpaid administrative fine, or the amount of a settlement made without the use of cash register equipment;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 3) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, or the amount of the offender's expenditure on acquiring the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of the goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 3.1) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 3.2) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of fuel for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale of fuel in the preceding calendar year;
units.label: Point 3.2 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 3.3) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at a coal mine for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not extract coal (oil shale) at that coal mine in the preceding calendar year;
units.label: Point 3.3 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4) the amount of the offender's proceeds obtained from the sale of goods (works, services) as a result of unlawfully inflating state-regulated prices (tariffs, charges, rates and the like) over the entire period during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.1) repealed. — Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 28.04.2023;
units.label: Point 4.1 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 5) the initial (maximum) price of a civil-law agreement for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services (including the acquisition of immovable property or the lease of property) concluded on behalf of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipal formation, or by a budgetary institution or another legal entity in accordance with parts 1 and 4 - 6 of Article 15 of Federal Law No. 44-FZ of 5 April 2013 'On the Contract System for the Procurement of Goods, Works and Services to Meet State and Municipal Needs' (hereinafter referred to as a contract), or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider);
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 6) the amount of excess income or the amount of losses that a person avoided as a result of the unlawful use of inside information and (or) market manipulation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 7) the undeclared amount of cash and (or) the value of monetary instruments;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 8) the amount of funds received from a budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation and used for purposes other than those designated, or the amount of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of the fee for the use of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of a budget loan received, or the amount of a budget investment received, or the amount of a subsidy received, or the amount of funds to be credited to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of funds involved in unlawfully conducted transactions;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 3.5
